// diagnostic

E0396

Jet writes power as `value.pow(exponent)`, not `**`.

What

Jet writes power as `value.pow(exponent)`, not `**`.

Why

`**` is a power operator in some other languages; Jet uses the `pow` method.

Fix

Write `base.pow(exponent)`, for example `2.pow(3)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0396: tests/ui/power_double_star_e0396.stderr.

Error [jet.ForeignPowerOperator]: Jet writes power as `value.pow(exponent)`, not `**`.
  --> tests/ui/power_double_star_e0396.jet:2:13
    |
  2 |     print(2 ** 3)
    |             ^^
 Why: `**` is a power operator in some other languages; Jet uses the `pow` method.
 Fix: Write `base.pow(exponent)`, for example `2.pow(3)`.
